balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.hint: Parry and Feint rolls with it get +2k0.

accurate.label: Accurate
accurate.hint: Extra +1k0 to hit when Aiming; aimed single-shot single-target attacks add +1k1 damage per two raises.

armMounted.label: Arm Mounted
armMounted.hint: Wielder keeps that hand free; weapon counts as permanently readied.

armored.label: Armored
armored.hint: +2 AP to the wielding arm and the body; bonuses from several shields do not stack.

beam.label: Beam
beam.hint: Continuous beam: may reuse the previous attack roll against the same target; switching targets breaks it.

blast.label: Blast
blast.hint: Hits everything within X metres of the impact point; attack, hit location and damage are rolled once.

brawling.label: Brawling
brawling.hint: Uses Brawl instead of Weaponry; counts as unarmed, replaces normal unarmed damage, wounds inflict fatigue.

combiweapon.label: Combiweapon
combiweapon.hint: Module attachable to a weapon of the same class or larger; fire it in place of the host weapon.

compact.label: Compact
compact.hint: Easy to hide (+10 TN to find); a Compact Basic weapon fired one-handed ignores the one-hand penalty.

defensive.label: Defensive
defensive.hint: +1k1 on parries, -2k0 on attacks; if not proficient the -2k0 applies to all your attacks.

flame.label: Flame
flame.hint: No attack roll: 30-degree cone to weapon range; victims make Dex Test (TN 5x firer Ballistics, craftsmanship adjusted) or take damage.

inaccurate.label: Inaccurate
inaccurate.hint: Gains nothing from the Aim action.

orgoneArray.label: Orgone Array
orgoneArray.hint: When its damage dice explode, a Psychic Phenomena roll occurs centred on the target.

overheats.label: Overheats
overheats.hint: On a jam, wielder takes E damage equal to weapon damage to an arm unless he drops it (free action); must reload.

powerField.label: Power Field
powerField.hint: Parrying against or being parried by a non-Power Field weapon: d10, 4+ destroys it (natural/artifact weapons immune).

proven.label: Proven
proven.hint: Reroll damage dice showing less than the Proven value.

razorSharp.label: Razor Sharp
razorSharp.hint: With two or more raises on the hit, its Pen (AP) is doubled.

reach.label: Reach
reach.hint: Can engage and attack from one extra metre; no engagement penalty unless foe has similar reach or is adjacent.

recharge.label: Recharge
recharge.hint: After a shot it cannot shoot again this round or next round, unless you spend a Half Action priming it.

scatter.label: Scatter
scatter.hint: Point blank: +1k0 damage per two raises; at long or extreme range armour counts double.

shocking.label: Shocking
shocking.hint: A wounded target must pass a Con Test (TN 20) or be stunned one round.

smoke.label: Smoke
smoke.hint: On a hit creates a smokescreen 3d10 m across lasting 2d10 rounds (less in bad weather).

snare.label: Snare
snare.hint: Target makes Dex Test vs the hitting roll or is immobilised; escape by Str/Dex Test (TN 10/15/20 by quality) as half action.

storm.label: Storm
storm.hint: On full auto each raise gives +2k0 instead of +1k0 (still capped by RoF).

tearing.label: Tearing
tearing.hint: Round up instead of down when dividing damage by Resilience.

toxic.label: Toxic
toxic.hint: After damage, target makes Con Test (TN 20) or suffers 1 wound to the body.

twinLinked.label: Twin Linked
twinLinked.hint: Single shot: +1k0 to hit; two or more raises add +2k0 damage.

unbalanced.label: Unbalanced
unbalanced.hint: -1k0 to Tests to parry with it.

unreliable.label: Unreliable
unreliable.hint: Jams on kept 1s and 2s (both count toward the jam check).

volatile.label: Volatile
volatile.hint: Its damage dice explode on a 9 as well as a 10.

Hint.grappled: In a grapple: no Movement actions.

Hint.lostEye: Ranged range halved; −2k1 on sight Tests.
Hint.lostLeg: As a lost foot, and no Dodge.
Hint.grappling: Controls a grapple: each turn a Full Action and opposed Strength to pick an option.

social.hint: For social scenes; not usable in combat.

somatic.hint: Needs free movement; not while bound, grappled or restrained.

subtle.label: Subtle
subtle.hint: Not obvious; other casters notice it with Arcana + Wisdom TN 20.

touch.label: Touch
touch.hint: The caster touches the target; an unwilling one takes an unarmed Brawl attack.

verbal.label: Verbal
verbal.hint: The caster must speak clearly and loudly; not while silenced.
